notes.title: Escalation Update is now live! New Game Mode, New maps, New Mechanic!
notes.notes:
New FeaturesEscalation Game Mode
This is an evolution of the Skirmish mode, where you compete on randomized levels to be the first to accumulate enough points, and between rounds you get to upgrade your towers and add new passives.



Note, to unlock this mode you need to win a single skirmish match!


Resistance/Vulnerability System
Attacks now have damage types, and different units/towers are vulnerable/resistant to these attacks.


Unit Info Screen
There is now a screen that gives the detailed info on units and structures stats, including their new resistances/vulnerabilities. Check it out!


New Missions
The final two missions of the Chromatech campaign have been released, with a level playing with a Wave Attack mode intended for the global domination game mode, and a climatic showdown with the U.C.F..


Pay attention for some hints of the next faction!


New Tower Upgrades/Passives
We added a few more upgrades and passives now that Escalation mode is out and you can use them there.


New Map
Bastion: A new dual Wave Defence / Skirmish map designed by a member of the community.


Updates/Bug Fixes

Sniper Tower Rework
The sniper tower wasn’t as fun as we wanted, so we redid the way it works, it now fires all the time normally, and if you hover over a target in range and los it will focus it, instead of focusing the player’s cursor at all times.



Nerfed Field Promotion for being way too OP

Fixed some scoreboard bugs and made it so you can see the global high score without having to have a score of your own first.

Tuning powers/structures for better balance

Continued to improve performance

Improved/optimized pathfinding for better performance and less units getting stuck

Fixed a variety of localization issues


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124850/_/"][/dynamiclink]

Thanks for playing, and as always – we love hearing your feedback. Join the discussion, share your chaos combos, and let us know what you think!   

- RattleAxe Games

notes.title: Summer Discount&Update is now live! New Feature, New maps, New System!
notes.notes:
New FeaturesFlying Units and Structures
Both factions have received a new unit, and a structure to produce that unit.

Helicopter: The UCF now have an attack helicopter that can hover over water to capture territories. Produced by the Helipad.

Zedplin: Chromatech now have a hot air balloon that fires zombies, which excels at hunting down enemy artillery. Produced by the Rigor Riser.


This also comes with a new passive available in Wave Defence, Air Commander, that allows you to take to the field to directly control air units!
New Modifier
The Happening modifier has been added to both wave defence and skirmish modes. This modifier allows for various events to occur. Right now just the Blood Moon, raising all corpses as neutral zombies, and Lightning Storm, however more will be added as time goes on.
New Commanders
Each faction got a new Commander, with a new power and one new passive.

Instructor: The UCF got a commander with the Field Promotion power, upgrading all grunts in range to the nearest special tile. Their passive grants bonus stats to elite units.

Economist: Chromatech got a commander with Zombonomics, a power that converts zombies in the area into bonus stock for the nearby territories.
New Missions
The next two Chromatech missions chronicling Dr. Strangehue’s quest for revenge have been released, bringing the Chromatech campaign to near the end and featuring the new flying units.


Global High Scores
Campaign and Wave Defence maps now have the option to see the global high scores close to you, so you can compete to be the best in the world!


New Map
Wing Tide: A new dual Wave Defence / Skirmish map focusing on aerial units


Handicap/Bonus System
There is now an option in skirmish games to add a bonus or handicap to human players. This allows for novice players to fight on even footing with more experienced ones.


Wave Defence Economy Revamp
Structures that produced bonus resources were too strong in Endless Mode, so they were reduced by ½ in that mode (single resource structures go down to a 50% chance of getting 1). Also, a new structure, the Bank, has been added as a potential Permastructure in the store in Wave Defence. This gives 2 resources per wave in Wave Defence and 1 in Endless.


Updates/Bug Fixes
Continued to juice the effects of the game

Tuning powers/structures for better balance

Continued to improve performance

Improved/optimized pathfinding for better performance and less units getting stuck

Made waves 20+ harder on Endless Mode

Fixed a variety of localization issues

Fixed some crash bugs related to unit removal/summoning

Thanks for playing, and as always – we love hearing your feedback. Join the discussion, share your chaos combos, and let us know what you think!   

- RattleAxe Games

notes.title: Game Mode Update Streaming
notes.notes:
Commanders! A new update has landed for D.O.T. Defence, packed with new modes, missions, maps, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:

🎮 New Skirmish Modes!

 Boss Mode: Replace your HQ with a super unit and dive into twin-stick shooter combat!
 Armistice Mode: Ceasefires after a set time give you space to regroup and rebuild.
 Warzone Mode: Face off against relentless Shadow Government waves – or use the chaos to crush your enemies.

These modes can be combined for ultimate mayhem.

🧪 New Campaign Missions
Dr. Strangehue’s revenge continues with two new Chromatech missions, marking the halfway point of the campaign.

💥 Campaign Difficulty + Scoring
Choose your challenge! Now with difficulty settings and a scoring system that rewards high-skill play, it's perfect for competing with friends.

🗺️ New Maps

 Logic Gates: 1v1 Chromatech biome map for tight tactical battles.
 Dead End: A new wave defence map where barricade placement is key to survival.


🕹️ Keyboard + Gamepad Co-op
No more extra controllers needed! Play local co-op using just a single gamepad + keyboard/mouse setup.

🔧 Other Improvements + Fixes

 New faction art by Tim Mack
 Clearer metaprogression alerts
 Buffs to expensive structures
 Pathfinding optimisations
 Harder Endless Mode (waves 20+)
 Crash & localisation fixes
 Screenshake toggle
 Improved team AI in Skirmish
 Wave defence balance: bonus resources now require early placement


Thanks for playing, and as always – we love hearing your feedback. Join the discussion, share your chaos combos, and let us know what you think! 

- RattleAxe Games

notes.title: Patch Notes 10/14/2024
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!

We’re excited to bring you another update for D.O.T. Defence! Here’s what’s new and improved:


Localization
We’ve added support for new languages:

Chinese
French
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/c614cea189b8c3c48a4e124163a33127fa18ccd0.png
A language selector is now available in the game menu, and if no language is detected, the game will default to the main menu where you can select the appropriate flag! 

New Maps
Explore and conquer our two new maps:

Hue Silo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/6b19eeb51b55ba166f8f853fe44823bfaa6b4870.jpg
Bridge Maze
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/56df1b734e5812ec6845eac489ee065349a1f338.jpg

UI and UX Improvements
We’ve made key enhancements to improve your experience:
-Redesigned the map select screen for a cleaner layout and improved button colors.
-Improved overall feedback across the UI, ensuring better clarity in key interactions.

Gameplay Enhancements
We’ve refined gameplay flow to speed up downtime and increase strategic depth:
-AI pathfinding now takes distance into account for more tactical movement.
-Trucks now move faster between waves, reducing downtime.

Map Adjustments
We’ve made tweaks to the maps for smoother gameplay:
-Completed tuning of the Bridge Maze for a more balanced challenge.
-Added line drawing for bridges in Mission 2.
-Final path node now automatically rotates to face the last node’s direction.

Bug Fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/2fcb1253d313e9621b8db18fdb20247a1c9a7948.png
We’ve resolved several bugs to improve overall stability:
-Fixed viewport snap issues for smoother transitions.
-The bridge on Hue Silo is now part of the navigation layer.
-Updated compendium videos and screenshots where needed.
-Fixed "power ready" bark in wave defense.
-Improved mouse UI for player selection.
-Fixed an issue where the player selection slot wasn’t displayed.
-Smoothed out long jump stitching in mouse line drawing.
-Dropdown menus now correctly consume back input.

Also today we're featured during Steam Next Fest! Please check it out and give us a review on our Steam Demo Page, it'll be a huge help to our game. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/9a157426b347bab33ced2eb5071aa2d28c4c15dc.png

Stay tuned for more updates! Thank you for your continued support, and keep sharing your feedback, videos, and art as we refine D.O.T. Defence.

Best regards,
The RattleAxe Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 10/6/2024
notes.notes:
Greetings Commanders!
We’re excited to bring you another update for D.O.T. Defence! Here’s what’s new and improved:

New Features & Improvements

Single Player Missions Added!
The campaign is here! We’re introducing the first three single-player missions, each offering unique challenges to test your strategy and sharpen your skills:

Mission 1: Ready for action with Paradrops! Your goal: Defend the HQ from relentless assaults.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/d40b2c6d67ccf7698388854feacfcf6d13cd4832.png
Mission 2: A timed mission with high stakes. Capture the facility before it wipes out your HQ!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/fb59815bcd03c2be9d2167fcd2e0e4f61209e87f.png
Mission 3: Command a Super Tank and show those Blues who’s in charge!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/58b0d56f6be9a74408c39c3bfcd379e4a5bc1bcf.png

New Trailer

Our new trailer showcases a lot of the above missions and how you can go about picking and choosing the levels! We're especially happy to implement the previously mentioned Possession mechanic! Check it out!
[previewyoutube=gMbHgF8Dsms;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]



Turret Buffs
Turrets are now more powerful! We’ve increased their Time to Kill (TTK) to make them deadlier, ensuring a more satisfying defense experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/6ef6e6e85fa09fca3096876b194f8198e9c8a135.png

New Portraits
New character portraits have been added! You can now choose from additional AI and female portraits, offering more personalization options for your commander.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/ccaa3b5c2596228261a846f0e70d788f0320cce9.png
General Animation Updates
Our UI has received a facelift with smoother animations, making it more fluid and responsive. The game feels sharper and more polished than ever before!

Quality of Life Enhancements  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/2fcb1253d313e9621b8db18fdb20247a1c9a7948.png
Additional Tooltips
To improve accessibility, we’ve added more tooltips throughout the game. These will help you quickly grasp key mechanics and features, whether you’re a new player or a seasoned veteran.

General Optimizations
We’ve enhanced pathfinding and unit handling to improve overall movement, making your units more responsive and agile on the battlefield.


What’s Coming Up?
We’ve been gearing up for Steam Next Fest and other game festivals! Expect more exciting features, announcements, and improvements in the coming weeks as we continue to refine and expand D.O.T. Defence. We've also been hard at work continuing on localization, with the furthest progress on French, so stay tuned for that fellow francophones!

Stay Connected!

We couldn’t do this without you. Your support helps us grow, so keep making videos, art, and sharing your experiences with D.O.T. Defence. Be sure to follow our youtube, twitter and tiktok channels! Together, we’ll build something amazing!


Best regards,
The RattleAxe Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 9/23/2024 - D.O.T. Defence
notes.notes:
Greetings Commanders!

We’re happy to bring you our third exciting update for D.O.T. Defence! Here’s what’s new:

Dyslexia-Friendly Font: We’ve switched to a new dyslexia-friendly font. Not only does it enhance readability, but we’ve also come to love the new look. We hope it makes your experience even smoother.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/c7add07a0ead20f5997dc53512ead88862e3229d.png

Campaign Missions: We’ve begun work on the game’s campaign! These missions will guide players through essential skills and strategies, teaching you how to effectively master the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/e4e343e020fc1079ec37c3620854a8b5e30450e6.png

Interactive Environment - Bridges: You can now interact with bridges in the environment! Blow them up to hinder enemy advances or repair them to guide your forces in a more tactical approach. Strategic use of bridges will now become key in your defense.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/3e7a32413979654dbc5f48edefd9e971ccaddad3.png


New Commander Ability - Paradrop: Paratroopers have arrived! Use the new Paradrop ability to bring reinforcements into battle. Be aware, though—one recruit is still learning the ropes, so they may jump a little early!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/e5d3fb1cb34b8a5f60c5cedd18614a1a84dc6dfd.png

Exciting Features in Testing

Special Unit Control: We’re currently testing a feature that may allow for direct control of a special unit! It’s still in the early stages, so we’ll reveal more in future updates. Stay tuned!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/5d963fdfe9ff3c8b8a6cb9929548c008bb0709cd.png

Super Structures: We’re also testing super structures that you’ll need to capture. These structures will come with special win conditions, adding a fresh layer of strategy to the game. They’re not available just yet as we need to playtest them further, but they’re on the horizon!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/fb59815bcd03c2be9d2167fcd2e0e4f61209e87f.png


Tileset and Biomes

Bog Biome: We’re testing a new biome—bogs. Units and vehicles will move slower in these swampy areas, adding a new layer of challenge. On the flip side, vehicles will speed up when moving on roads.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/24a24ce445514ded62ec5b914bc489b9b03af0e6.png

Tuning and Balancing

We’ve done significant balancing and tuning for various structures, powers, and units to complement new commander abilities. Expect smoother gameplay and more strategic possibilities.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/2fcb1253d313e9621b8db18fdb20247a1c9a7948.png

Taunt System

New Taunt System: Taunts are now available in the main menu and on the scoreboard. We’re testing out female voice options for these, so be sure to check them out and let us know what you think!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/3c4e93aa824483dd1b78f46589029f285628c0e9.png

What’s Next?

We’ll continue refining the campaign missions, expand on commander abilities, and work toward introducing these exciting new features. Additionally, we’re focusing on leaderboards and improving the game’s accessibility through localization.

Stay Connected!

Follow us on Twitter, YouTube, and Steam for the latest updates. Your feedback keeps us going strong!

Thank You!

Your ongoing support is invaluable. Keep playing, reviewing, and sharing D.O.T. Defence with your friends!

Best regards,

The RattleAxe Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 9/4/2024 - D.O.T. Defence
notes.notes:
Greetings Commanders!

We're excited to share the latest updates for D.O.T. Defence!

:wrench: New Features & Improvements


- Added map preview art: We've added a system to display a simplified preview when you're selecting a map. This will let you better view what to expect when you jump into the game. More maps in general are to come!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/34d35968106258de81a00e7380450aebc42929c5.png

-Updated Tileset: We've enhanced the visuals with new isocubes to better convey depth and improve readability. So far this is a first pass at the new system, but it's more modular than ever and will let us decorate the heck out of our current and future maps!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/84f933ade4d9f6b788e4fcda73cb6a8e59435840.png


-Wave Defense Leaderboard System: This feature is still being developed, however if you or other friends over steam wish to battle for the highest score in our PvE mode, now you can! At the end of a match, press the Y button to toggle the leaderboard list next to your overall score.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/e300c1730eab4b8c1e5d70f29af435ad240e5158.png

-New Buildings: Introducing a streamlined design for our buildings. The updated assets are more intuitive and easier to understand at a glance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/cc7c364d82111a39ce06377b6dc2cd4b8fc08fc4.png

-Hover Tooltip: Added a hover tooltip feature for bonus tiles. When you hover over a bonus tile for 1 second, a descriptive tooltip will pop up to help you make informed decisions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/42d4a3da4ca7e83629db98b649322b27fd5a7e88.png

-Zoom In System: A new zoom-in feature has been added to the tutorial, making it easier to follow along and understand the gameplay mechanics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/e154037f8cd2ce3d85385c51df6bb85585a99582.png

-UI Animation Changes: We've refined UI animations for a smoother, more cohesive experience. Expect more fluid transitions and visual feedback throughout the game.


What’s Next?

We're planning exciting updates including new units, different factions, expanded commander abilities, and a fun campaign to gradually teach you the game’s mechanics. We’re also looking into different localization options! Follow us on Twitter, YouTube, or right here on Steam for the latest news.

Thank You!

Your support is crucial to our journey. Keep playing, reviewing, and sharing D.O.T. Defence with your friends. Each bit of feedback helps us make the game even better!

Best regards,

The RattleAxe Games Team
